parse.title: Fisherman Gerald
parse.text:
Fisherman Gerald
Type
NPC
Quests
Finding the Engine
Description
Introduces the player to the Ship Navigator and allows them to fish up the  Rusty Ship Engine to fix it.
Location
 Fishing Outpost
Coordinates
118.5 71 -32.5

Fisherman Gerald is an NPC located in the  Fisherman's Hut. He introduces the player to the Ship Navigator and allows players to fish up the  Rusty Ship Engine.

Contents

  • 1 Dialogue
  • 2 Trivia
  • 3 History
  • 4 Navigation

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
 Fisherman's Hut Below  Fishing V (5)
[NPC] Gerald: Hmm, you're not quite ready yet.
[NPC] Gerald: Go talk to the Fishing Merchant in the Fishing Outpost, get geared up, and get fishin'!
[NPC] Gerald: Come back once you've reached Fishing Skill V and I'll tell you how you can get to a new island!
First interaction above  Fishing V (5)
[NPC] Gerald: Keep the noise down, kid!
[NPC] Gerald: If you want to learn about Fishing, go talk to my wife, Fisherwoman Enid.
[NPC] Gerald: She's fishing a bit upstream. Once she's shown you the ropes, come back and talk to me!
After talking to Fisherwoman Enid
[NPC] Gerald: Hey there buddy, think you can help me out?
Select an option: [What do you need?]
After selecting [What do you need?]
[NPC] Gerald: My buddy, Captain Baha, and I are just about done building a ship that can set sail to the Backwater Bayou.
[NPC] Gerald: All that's left is to add the Rusty Ship Engine, but I tripped and dropped it into the pond here...
[NPC] Gerald: Do you think you could fish it out for me?
[NPC] Gerald: If you find it, bring it to Captain Baha so you can set sail!
Before fishing up the  Rusty Ship Engine
[NPC] Gerald: Can you fish up the Rusty Ship Engine for me?
[NPC] Gerald: It's somewhere in this pond here.
[NPC] Gerald: Once you fish it out, you can set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
After fishing the  Rusty Ship Engine
[NPC] Gerald: Ah! The Rusty Ship Engine! Perfect!
[NPC] Gerald: Bring that to Captain Baha and he'll be able to help you set sail!
[NPC] Gerald: He's behind the Fisherman's Hut, waiting by the Ship.
[NPC] Gerald: Just leave out the part about me dropping it, would ya?
After bringing the  Rusty Ship Engine to Captain Baha
[NPC] Gerald: Thanks for helping me find the Rusty Ship Engine, <username>!
[NPC] Gerald: You can use the Ship Navigator to set sail to the Backwater Bayou!
[NPC] Gerald: Safe travels!
Idle
[NPC] Gerald: Fishing is the family business.
[NPC] Gerald: Enid and I are thrilled that our two children love it as much as we do!
[NPC] Gerald: I met Captain Baha when I was marooned on a distant pirate cove.
[NPC] Gerald: He saved my skin then, and I'm forever grateful to him.
[NPC] Gerald: I've only gone lava fishing a few times in my life.
[NPC] Gerald: I prefer the open water. More peaceful, less Ghasts!
 The Garden None
[NPC] Fisherman Gerald: A Carrot King has been scaring off all the good fish, I need to deal with it before I lose more fish.
Completing
[NPC] Fisherman Gerald: Holy Mackerel! You got me the whole nine yards.
Denying
[NPC] Fisherman Gerald: S'alright, we are all busy some days.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Fisherman Gerald is married to Fisherwoman Enid, their children are Gwynnie and Gavin.
  • Fisherman Gerald's dialogue mentions a distant pirate cove, which refers to a Fishing island that was once planned but has since been scrapped.
